raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 with about 340 duplicate txn_ids, and the re-delivered copies store txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, which fails the TIMESTAMP cast. The epoch value 1768543211000 equals 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, the same instant as the original row, so the fix is to convert epoch-millisecond timestamps, keep one row per txn_id (earliest ingest_ts), and then apply the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH conv AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))) AS txn_ts, status, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions), ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) AS rn FROM conv) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
